Class FlowUtilsTest

@IsTest()
private class FlowUtilsTest

Test class for FlowUtils that validates all invocable method routing and execution. Tests password generation, UUID generation, commission report URLs, invoice numbering, settings retrieval, Stripe transaction synchronization, lead archiving, checkout-to-ledger promotion, Flow interview publishing, and quote PDF generation functionality.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void archiveLeadTest()

Tests the lead archiving functionality by invoking the archiveLead method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Creates a test Lead record, then validates that the expected success message is returned.

@IsTest
private static void generatePasswordTest()

Tests the password generation functionality by invoking the generatePassword method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Validates that the returned password is not blank.

@IsTest
private static void generateQuotePdfTest()

Tests the quote PDF generation functionality by invoking the generateQuotePdf method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Creates a test Account and Quote, injects PDF template settings via CodeSettings.setValue, then validates that a QuoteDocument record is created for the quote.

Since:
    03/20/2026

@IsTest
private static void generateUUIDTest()

Tests the UUID generation functionality by invoking the generateUUID method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Validates that the returned UUID is not blank.

@IsTest(seeAllData=true)
private static void getCommissionsDetailReportDownloadUrlTest()

Tests the commission detail report download URL generation by invoking the getCommissionsDetailReportDownloadUrl method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Creates test data including a BlazeBite account, contact agent, and commission payment, then validates that a properly formatted download URL is returned. Requires SeeAllData to access the report metadata.

@IsTest
private static void getNextInvoiceNumberTest()

Tests the invoice number generation functionality by invoking the getNextInvoiceNumber method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Creates a test account with an AccountPrefix__c of 'TA' and an existing invoice 'TA-0001', then validates that the next invoice number 'TA-0002' is correctly generated.

@IsTest
private static void getSettingMapValueTest()

Tests the map-based settings retrieval functionality by invoking the getSettingMapValue method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Retrieves the value of the 'price' key from the 'SETTING_6' configuration and validates that the expected value '10' is returned.

Since:
    03/20/2026

@IsTest
private static void getSettingValueTest()

Tests the settings retrieval functionality by invoking the getSettingValue method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Retrieves the value of the 'SETTING_1' configuration from CodeSettings and validates that the expected value '1' is returned.

@IsTest
private static void promoteCheckoutToLedgerTest()

Tests the checkout-to-ledger promotion functionality by invoking the promoteCheckoutToLedger method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Creates test bill data using TestDataFactory.TestBillSuite, then validates that the expected promotion success message is returned.

@IsTest
private static void publishFlowInterviewTest()

Tests the publishFlow method by publishing a Flow interview via FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Validates that a non-blank JobKey__c is returned and an AsyncJob__c record is persisted.

Since:
    03/08/2026

@IsTest
private static void startFlowInterviewTest()

Tests the enqueueFlow method by enqueuing a Flow interview via FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Validates that the Flow is enqueued asynchronously and a non-blank response is returned.

Since:
    03/07/2026

@IsTest
private static void syncStripeChargesTest()

Tests the Stripe transaction synchronization functionality by invoking the syncStripeTransaction method through FlowUtils.executeMethod(). Creates a mock Stripe API response containing charge data with a payment intent ID, then validates that a StripeTransaction__c record is created with the correct PaymentIntentId__c and that an AsyncJob__c record is created for the StripeTransactionProcessor job.

Since:
    11/08/2025
